test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

A bird's eye view

options.text: A clear impression of what is happening
To hold a negative or pessimistic opinion on something
To move or rise into sight, especially from a distance

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A bird's eye view"** means a clear impression of what is happening; it refers to a broad or comprehensive perspective. (एक स्पष्ट दृष्टिकोण)

 
 
• **Example: **From the top of the hill, we got a bird's eye view of the entire town.
 
 
 
• **"A bird's eye view"** refers to a comprehensive understanding or overview of a situation. (एक व्यापक दृष्टिकोण)
 
 
• **Example: **The CEO provided a bird's eye view of the company's strategy during the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2: A limited understanding of something** (किसी चीज़ की सीमित समझ): A narrow or restricted perspective on a matter.

 
 
• **Example:** His limited understanding of the topic made it difficult for him to contribute to the discussion.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To hold a negative or pessimistic opinion on something** (किसी चीज़ पर नकारात्मक या निराशावादी राय रखना): To have a gloomy or unfavorable viewpoint.
 
 
• **Example: **He always holds a negative opinion about new policies introduced at work.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To move or rise into sight, especially from a distance** (विशेष रूप से दूरी से दृष्टि में आना या उठना): To become visible or noticeable from afar.
 
 
• **Example:** As we drove closer, the mountain began to rise into sight.
 
 

147:Tbe1,
The correct answer is **Option (1)** i.e. **CBDA**
